# PromptDNS

> Free DNS, email authentication, and AI-readiness tools: 56 browser-based checkers for SPF, DKIM, DMARC, DNSSEC, propagation, blocklists, and AI crawler access, each paired with deep technical guides. No sign-up required. Every DNS lookup runs in your browser over DNS-over-HTTPS (RFC 8484); nothing is stored on our servers. Continuous domain monitoring with alerts is in early access.

## Flagship tools

- [Homepage security scanner](https://promptdns.com/): one-pass audit of DNS, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, DNSSEC, MX, and nameservers with a weighted 0-100 score.
- [DNS Propagation Checker](https://promptdns.com/dns-propagation-checker/): compare answers across Cloudflare, Google, and AliDNS for 12 record types.
- [DNS Record Lookup](https://promptdns.com/dns-record-lookup/): fetch A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, SOA, PTR, SRV, CAA, DS, DNSKEY, and TXT records with full values and TTLs.
- [SPF Record Checker](https://promptdns.com/spf-record-checker/): validate v=spf1 syntax and count DNS-querying mechanisms against the RFC 7208 limit of 10.
- [DKIM Record Checker](https://promptdns.com/dkim-record-checker/): verify selector keys, key length, and signing properties.
- [DMARC Record Checker](https://promptdns.com/dmarc-record-checker/): validate v=DMARC1 policy, rua reporting, pct, and alignment tags.
- [DMARC Report Analyzer](https://promptdns.com/dmarc-report-analyzer/): upload aggregate report XML or ZIP files and read source IPs, SPF/DKIM results, and dispositions locally in the browser.
- [Email Header Analyzer](https://promptdns.com/email-header-analyzer/): parse Received chains and Authentication-Results from raw email headers.
- [Blacklist Checker](https://promptdns.com/blacklist-checker/): check IPs and domains against major DNS blocklists.
- [AI Crawler Checker](https://promptdns.com/ai-crawler-checker/): test whether GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, PerplexityBot, and other AI crawlers can access your site.

## Guides

- [What Is DNS?](https://promptdns.com/what-is-dns/): the Domain Name System from first principles.
- [SPF Record](https://promptdns.com/spf-record/): syntax, the 10-lookup limit, and how to fix it.
- [DKIM](https://promptdns.com/dkim/): cryptographic email signing explained.
- [DMARC](https://promptdns.com/dmarc/): policy, reporting, and the enforcement roadmap from p=none to p=reject.
- [Email Authentication](https://promptdns.com/email-authentication/): the full cluster: mechanisms, policies, reports, BIMI, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, and ARC.
- [AI Web Infrastructure](https://promptdns.com/ai-web-infrastructure/): crawlers, llms.txt, and AI readiness.

## Provider playbooks

- [Cloudflare](https://promptdns.com/manage-dns-in-cloudflare/), [GoDaddy](https://promptdns.com/manage-dns-in-godaddy/), [Namecheap](https://promptdns.com/manage-dns-in-namecheap/), [Route 53](https://promptdns.com/manage-dns-in-route53/), [Azure DNS](https://promptdns.com/manage-dns-in-azure-dns/): step-by-step DNS management for each provider, with field mappings and gotchas.
